name: Elmo Costa
source:
Elmo is a boy who was found beside a lake one fine day and was later brought up by Arumand, the caretaker. But for some reason, Arumand disappeared, leaving Elmo to take over his place, fighting to not lose Tuesday. He’s also the extremely kind protag type, who’s donkan and attracts girls without noticing. But he has a sensible streak in him, which makes him bearable.
